description: Lugares do Concelho de Porto de Mós is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Porto de Mós. Limit of the seats of the Municipality of Porto de Mós for official purposes of location and normalization of addresses. Coverage: Município de Porto de Mós. The portal shows the English title as "Places of the Municipality of Porto de Mós" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Porto de Mós. Its keywords include concelho-de-porto-de-mos, porto-de-mos, lugares, limites-de-lugares. The listing shows 2025-10-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
